Short answer

To install omarchy-fish on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omarchy-fish. It is a 27.4 KB download (53.8 KB installed), version 1.5.0-1, licensed MIT. Omarchy shell configuration for Fish. Free and open source (MIT licensed).

Install omarchy-fish on Omarchy

Omarchy Fish is a configuration package that turns the Fish shell into a more productive out-of-the-box experience, adding custom functions, completions, and keybindings tuned for common developer tasks. It bundles fzf.fish for fuzzy-searching directories, git logs, shell history, and running processes, reachable through a set of Ctrl-based shortcuts. It also includes a small setup utility to make Fish your default shell.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omarchy-fish
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.5.0-1:
    pacman -Qi omarchy-fish

Open and use omarchy-fish

omarchy-fish has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql omarchy-fish | grep /usr/bin/

omarchy-fish requirements and compatibility

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omarchy-fish on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omarchy-fish. The download is 27.4 KB and it takes 53.8 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omarchy-fish free?

Free and open source (MIT licensed). The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall omarchy-fish?

Run omarchy pkg drop omarchy-fish. It removes the package from your system.

What does omarchy-fish depend on?

The package declares 8 dependencies: fish, eza, mise, zoxide, starship, fzf, fd, bat. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omarchy-fish a desktop app?

No. omarchy-fish has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is omarchy-fish in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omarchy-fish (version 1.5.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Omacom makes it. Project site: https://github.com/omacom-io/omarchy-fish.
